summary: Two demonstrated failures: translation-only variation preserves answer-predicting formula cues, and normal generation excludes a complete source family. The exact delivered batch remains vulnerable. Mathematics, native grading, rendering and packaging passed. Package files remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve a Bernoulli differential equation by substitution, integrating factors and recovery of the original dependent variable; select its general solution.
reasoning_steps: Normalize the equation and identify p(x), q(x) and n.
Set z=y^(1-n) and derive the first-order linear equation.
Apply an integrating factor and integrate.
Substitute back, respect real branches and distinguish the solution from distractors.
invariants: Preserve the Bernoulli reduction and elementary integration workload.
Retain the observed five-choice radio response contract.
Keep prompts, solution branches, choices and keys mathematically consistent.
permitted_variations: Change eligible coefficients and signs while keeping integration elementary.
Retain complete source families with comparable workload.
Vary which formula patterns qualify; source-specific constants and answer positions are incidental.
